name: Toro Movers — Stage SMS drip (HubSpot delays)

nodes.name: Webhook stage SMS
nodes.notes: Point N8N_CRM_WEBHOOK_URL + N8N_STAGE_WEBHOOK_URL here. Accepts event=crm_lead | stage_changed with delayedSteps[]. Instant SMS already sent by toromovers.net. Forwards inbound x-toro-secret to stage-run (no $env — blocked on this host).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ stage: $json.stage, stepId: $json.stepId, firstName: $json.firstName, email: $json.email || undefined, phone: $json.phone || undefined, lang: $json.lang, consentSms: $json.consentSms, consentEmail: $json.consentEmail }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { skipped: true, reason: $input.first().json.reason || 'no steps' } }];
